info.name: AI Free Text Pro API
info.description:
Humanize and detect AI text with one REST call.

1. Create a key at https://developer.aifreetextpro.com/keys (500 free tokens on sign-up).
2. Set the collection variable `apiKey` to your key.
3. Send a request.

Docs: https://aifreetextpro.com/api/docs

Humanize costs 1 token per word (up to 5,000 words); detect costs 1 token per 5 words (up to 50,000 characters). Failed requests are not charged.

request.description:
Rewrites the text sentence by sentence and checks it with an AI detector; returns the lowest-scoring version. Can take up to ~2 minutes.

style: professional, academic, casual, creative, simple. strength: light, balanced, strong or 0-100. Optional: language (en, es, fr, de, nl, pt, it), return_versions (boolean).
Same as Humanize, with the text of every version so you can pick the one that reads best.
AI score from 0 to 100, a verdict (human under 40, mixed 40-69.9, ai 70+) and the flagged sentences.
